mapper.sql: a.id, a.title, a.activity_type, a.term, a.level, a.start_at, a.end_at, a.location, a.signup_deadline, a.quota, a.content, a.host, a.status, a.notice_url, a.created_by, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(c.real_name, ''), c.nickname, c.username) AS created_by_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_activity_signup s WHERE s.activity_id = a.id AND s.deleted = 0 AND s.status != 'rejected') AS signup_count
FROM community_activity a LEFT JOIN users c ON c.id = a.created_by

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_activity (title, activity_type, term, level, start_at, end_at, location, signup_deadline, quota, content, host, status, notice_url, created_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{title}, #{activityType}, #{term}, #{level}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{location}, #{signupDeadline}, #{quota}, #{content}, #{host}, #{status}, #{noticeUrl}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)

mapper.update: UPDATE community_activity SET title = #{activity.title}, activity_type = #{activity.activityType}, term = #{activity.term}, level = #{activity.level}, start_at = #{activity.startAt}, end_at = #{activity.endAt}, location = #{activity.location}, signup_deadline = #{activity.signupDeadline}, quota = #{activity.quota}, content = #{activity.content}, host = #{activity.host}, status = #{activity.status}, notice_url = #{activity.noticeUrl}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{activity.id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT a.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM community_activity a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.term = #{term} GROUP BY a.status ORDER BY a.status
SELECT a.activity_type AS activity_type, COUNT(*) AS total FROM community_activity a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.term = #{term} GROUP BY a.activity_type ORDER BY a.activity_type

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_activity a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.term = #{term}) AS total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_activity a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 'signup' AND a.term = #{term}) AS signup_open, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_activity_signup s WHERE s.deleted = 0) AS signup_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_activity_signup s WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.status = 'attended') AS attended_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_activity_signup s WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.award != 'none') AS award_total
